run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence criterion loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets
create_GTNLossFunction: create a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs to compute loss with parallel batch processing
build_make_target_graph: build a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to one or more input frames
review_forward_backward: review the forward and backward methods that use gtn.forward_score, gtn.intersect, and gtn.backward for graph scoring
test_GTNLoss_main: test the GTNLoss example by running main to compute loss and gradients on random batched inputs
